description: HTML file for TinyMCE plugin 'fullpage' with embedded JavaScript for UI interactions and form handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization function called on load to set up the plugin UI.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Handles form submission to update the fullpage settings.

methods.name: addHeadElm
methods.description: Adds a new head element (title, meta, script, style, link, base, comment).

methods.name: showAddMenu
methods.description: Displays the menu to add new head elements.

methods.name: updateHeadElm
methods.description: Updates the selected head element in the UI.

methods.name: updateElement
methods.description: Updates the current element's properties based on user input.

methods.name: changedStyleField
methods.description: Handles style field changes, updating the style accordingly.

methods.name: updateColor
methods.description: Updates color pickers and style fields for color properties.
